text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"'Customer happiness' is a deprecated, non-canonical metric","detail":"The sole success metric, 'Customer happiness', is listed as deprecated or ambiguous and must be mapped to Delivery CSAT for customers.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace it with Delivery CSAT. Note that Delivery CSAT measures delivery experience only, so consider whether it fits a support-chatbot change, and restate the baseline and target on that metric."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Responsible AI review not recorded","detail":"The proposal deploys a GenAI LLM chatbot on customer order data. The Responsible AI review is required, and the Reviews section only mentions vendor selection.","evidence_quote":"Deploy a GenAI chatbot using an LLM that identifies the customer by phone number and answers order status questions from order history.","citations":["policy-compliance#generative-ai-with-company-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Responsible AI review covering approved models, data handling, and human oversight before launch."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Privacy review not recorded","detail":"The chatbot identifies customers by phone number, which is personal data. No Privacy review is recorded.","evidence_quote":"identifies the customer by phone number","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Complete a Privacy review (purpose limitation, retention, authentication of the caller) and record it in the proposal."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"60% deflection claim has no source","detail":"The 60% contact deflection figure is stated as an expectation with no supporting data, benchmark, or pilot result.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a source such as vendor benchmarks or a pilot, or remove the figure and set the target from baseline data."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days minimum","detail":"The plan lists a 3-week duration, which meets the 14-day minimum. However, the 12-week success metric window does not match the 3-week test, so the primary metric cannot be read out within the experiment as designed.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Align the success metric timeframe with the experiment duration, or extend the test to cover the measurement window."}]}
